notes: The People page lists roughly 440 Faculty Associates, Affiliates and Fellows, the large majority with their primary appointment at other universities (not Harvard) and no email shown (bios only; the page's only contact emails are the general press@cyber.harvard.edu / hello@cyber.harvard.edu). Per CLAUDE.md's rule for policy centers ('the unit is the organization or one of its programs'), this file records BKC's own named internal labs/programs with a clear lead (Youth and Media Lab, metaLAB, Insight + Interaction Lab, Digital Technology and Democracy Lab) plus center leadership, rather than all ~440 external affiliates -- cataloguing every affiliate individually would mostly restate other institutions' own faculty pages with no BKC-specific contact info. Other named programs noticed but not given their own entry here for lack of a page-stated lead role: Applied Social Media Lab, Institute for Rebooting Social Media, Program on Behavioral Economics and Public Policy (Cass Sunstein), Social Economics Lab (Stefanie Stantcheva) -- these may deserve their own lab entries on a closer re-read. General contact: hello@cyber.harvard.edu, (617) 495-7547.
